summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.61/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.61 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 16, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 12¢ higher than a week ago, 13¢ lower than a month ago, and 74¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.36) and the highest in Superior ($3.98).
